free_notes_raw:
Key Features

• In-Browser Coding: Access to a cloud-based development environment with basic compute resources (typically 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory).
• AI & Agent Credits: Daily-resetting credits to experiment with the Replit Agent and basic AI assistance.
• Project Creation: Ability to build and edit code across web apps, slides, designs, and animations.
• Publishing: 1 free published app or deployment (using Lite build or Design Canvas).
• Built-in Databases: Access to basic cloud databases and object storage for full-stack prototyping.

Limitations

• Published App Expiration: Your single free published app goes offline automatically after 30 days.
• Replit Badge: Published apps display a “Made with Replit” referral badge.
• Usage Caps: Daily Agent and AI credits are strictly capped and refresh daily or monthly, meaning heavy AI usage will pause until reset.

name: GitHub Pages
description: Publish a static website from files in a GitHub repository. It suits portfolios, project documentation and browser-based tools, with more file and deployment setup than a visual website builder.
best_for: Host static websites from a repository
free_features: Free Pages hosting for eligible public repositories; static content only, with published service limits.
paid_features: Eligible paid GitHub plans permit Pages source repositories to be private. Hosting remains static; repository privacy does not itself make the published site private.
free_verdict: Use the free features above to assess your project; confirm current export, sharing and usage limits before starting.
free_notes_raw:
Key Features of the Free Tier

• Cost: $0/month with no expiration or credit card required.
• Repository Requirement: Your source code must live in a public repository. (Private repositories require a paid plan like Pro or Team).
• Supported Content: Static files only—including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and generators like Jekyll. No server-side code (PHP, Python, Node.js) or databases are supported.
• Custom Domains: Support for custom domains with free SSL/TLS certificates via Let's Encrypt.

Usage Limits

• Storage Limit: 1 GB per repository / published site.
• Bandwidth Limit: 100 GB per month (soft limit).
• Build Limit: 10 builds per hour (soft limit, which can be bypassed if using custom GitHub Actions).
• Site Cap: 1 user or organization site (<owner>.github.io) per account, plus unlimited project sites (<owner>.github.io/<repository-name>).
• Deployment Timeout: 10 minutes per build.
